_comment: Award winners, rendered into program.html and zh/program.html by scripts/build-program-html.py (never into the handbook). Each section has its own status: keep it "pending" until those awards are presented (paper awards: Welcome Banquet, 2026-11-20; presentation awards: Closing Ceremony, 2026-11-21), then set "announced". Each winner: {"paper": <program.json paper id>, "level": "award" (default) | "honorable-mention"}, listed in the order to show (oral presentation awards are grouped by track automatically). Sources: doc_resources/TAAI2026_BestPaperAwards/TAAI2026_Best_Paper_Award_20261117.xlsx (paper awards); the organizers' announcement of 2026-11-21 (presentation awards, one per session). Then run: python3 -I scripts/build-program-html.py
